description: Expandable detail rows in the Svelte 5 data grid. Click the chevron on an order and a full-width detail opens beneath it with four panels: line items, shipping events, a payment timeline and a support thread, staying in the row stream instead of a separate pane. The demo uses the grid's isDetailRow and renderDetailRow props with a DetailPanel snippet and virtualization off so each detail can take its natural height.

faq.question: How do I render a full-width row under a data row?
faq.answer: Insert a detail row into the data after the expanded row, tell the grid which rows are details with isDetailRow={(row) => row.kind === 'detail'}, and pass the component to render as renderDetailRow. The detail spans every column.

faq.question: Why is virtualization off here?
faq.answer: Row virtualization assumes a fixed rowHeight, and a detail panel with four sections is much taller. For long lists keep virtualization on and give detail rows a fixed height instead.

faq.question: How is the chevron column built?
faq.answer: A column whose cell snippet renders a button that toggles the order id in an open set; a $derived rebuilds the data array with detail rows spliced after every open order.
